main_text.p: rum Ciuitate patiamur, id nulla confequi poteft oratio. Turbatio enim turbatione fine vlla intermiffione excipit. Etenim magnificentiffimus Comes Candidianus, Milites fubinde in nos concitans, totam ciuitatem tumultuationib9 implet, omnibúfq; pænè vitæ neceffariis per excubias nos priuat.] Quid interim Cyrillus Concilij Præfes? quid tota Synodus? Cur non fuos ad fuppetias fibi ferendas per literas follicitant? Cur non Imperatorem excommunicant? Candidianum eius Legatum vel è ciuitate exturbant, vel palàm interficiendũ, vel deniq; clam veneno tollendum curant? quid? tota Synodus, eaque Oecumenica, quæ tot habuit cordatos Antiftites, quibus maxima Chriftiani Orbis pars fauebat, tantis laceffita iniurijs, nihil de vindicta Imperatori reddeda cogitat? prorfus nihil, quod ex eius Epiftola ad eundem Clerum Conftantinopolitanum apparet, quam vt ad Imperatoriam Majeftatem pro fe fupplex fiat, his verbis copellat. [Ad pietatem veftram confugientes, enixè rogamus, vt cum multâ fupplicatione & lachrymis, c Ibidem.Chri-

page.notes: The right margin note "c Ibidem." (italic) is at the bottom beside the last lines. Its reference mark "c" is not clearly visible in the running text, so I placed the note at the end of the paragraph. The "fto" at the foot right is treated as a catchword. The left edge (fragments of the previous page) is not transcribed. The macron over "reddeda" is uncertain at this resolution.
